ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "client_secret": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-id'), "name": attributes.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": attributes.headers.source, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var customer = (payload.result default [])[0] default { } --- { invoiceType: id: vars.billingAccountObject.id, transactionDesc: "Successful", channelId: "", msisdn: customer.Telefono_Movil default "", accountCode: "", balance: vars.inputPayload.amount, operationStaff: customer.Usuario_Creador default "", custName: customer.Nombre_Cliente default "", custType: customer.Tipo_Cliente default "", docType: customer.Tipo_Documento default "", docNumber: customer.Numero_Identificacion default "", departmentCode: "", cityCode: "", departmentName: customer.Departamento default "", cityName: customer.Ciudad default "", district: customer.Localidad default "", address: customer.Direccion default "", phoneNumber: customer.Telefono_Fijo default "", email: customer.Correo_Electronico default "", comments: "", chargingList: [{ billingNbr: "", basicCharge: "", acctItemTypeCode: "", taxList: [{ taxType: "", taxRate: "", taxAmount: "" }] }] }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { basePath: p("zsmart-sapi.base-path"), host: p("zsmart-sapi.host"), port: p("zsmart-sapi.port"), method: "GET", path: p('zsmart-sapi.resources.querySuscriberProfile.path'), body: vars.RequestInvoicePDF, headers: vars.queryHeaders default {}, queryParameters: { "serviceNumber": vars.queryParams.serviceNumber, "areaCode": vars.queryParams.areaCode }, uriParameters: {} }

logger.doc:name: RECARGA FALLIDA
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Recarga Fallida, No es posible notificar la recarga a Zsmart: " ++ (write(payload, "application/json")) ++ " | Status: " ++ ((attributes.statusCode default "N/A") as String)]
